name: Ashland University
tuition_note: Private university, single published rate. 2026-27 traditional full-time undergraduate tuition & fees ($35,400 tuition + $300 activity/service fee + $1,060 campus access fee = $36,760) from ashland.edu/traditional-undergraduate-tuition-fees. Housing (room only) is standard first-year double rate $3,625/semester = $7,250/year from ashland.edu/campus-student-housing; board not included (meal plans ~$3,140-$3,440/semester listed separately).
